payload.title: Falsify and integrate live-fusion causal mesh companion on Ubuntu
payload.work_clay: Starting from newest main, test research_entity/runtime/live_fusion_mesh_runtime.py and its tests against the current dynamic_work_runtime_v2.py + UnifiedDB V9 work fabric. Preserve WorkEvent v2.0 as baseline. Implement only the smallest adapter needed to derive two independent relevance target sets from current ClayGraph and UnifiedDB/dependency state, then exercise SemanticDeltaPulse -> ack/dedupe -> replan receipt -> reconciliation. Inject stale semantic epochs, duplicate event files, missed delivery/sync, ack loss, conflicting work revisions, process crash/restart and a critical invalidator arriving before effect. Compare FULL_NINE_BRANCH_BROADCAST, SINGLE_PROJECTION_TARGETING, DUAL_PROJECTION_ACK and DUAL_PROJECTION_ACK_PLUS_RECONCILIATION under matched inputs. Do not promote the candidate from synthetic evidence; retain rollback to existing WorkEvent transport.
payload.reason_clay: Current mesh distributes semantic deltas but does not explicitly close delivery->ingest->replan. Live research plus the 100-seed synthetic experiment found single-projection targeting fragile under stale topology; dual ClayGraph+UnifiedDB routing plus ack/idempotency and periodic anti-entropy repair preserved modeled eventual affected-branch recall with lower fanout. The next discriminating step is real repository/SQLite/Ubuntu execution rather than more architecture prose.
payload.completion_clay: Committed runtime is executed from a clean checkout; py_compile and test suite pass; adapter reads real current ClayGraph and UnifiedDB dependency/projection state without inventing a second semantic authority; matched failure-injection corpus covers stale epoch, duplicate pulse, missed sync, ack loss, conflicting work revision, restart and critical invalidator; duplicate application rate is zero; all required recipients on frozen corpus converge after reconciliation or candidate is refuted; p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU, RSS, DB/file amplification and message/fanout counts are captured with full host/build metadata; results are compared to current WorkEvent/broadcast baseline; rollback is demonstrated; Ubuntu/Hostinger receipt is written if that runner is actually used; affected branches receive evidence-class-preserving feedback; candidate remains RESEARCH_CANDIDATE unless promotion gate is independently satisfied.
payload.executor_policy: Prefer verified local Claude Code/build organ or Hostinger Ubuntu GitHub runner when available. This is subordinate to the ClayCode BASE critical path: integrate where it reuses current runtime/UnifiedDB work and does not block CC-WP-02..14. Re-read newest main and latest work revision before every effect. No paid training/API use. Simulation/research evidence must not be mislabeled runtime PASS.
invalidators: Executable evidence shows dual projection plus reconciliation is dominated by current WorkEvent/broadcast baseline under matched reliability/resource constraints
Current ClayGraph or UnifiedDB dependency surfaces cannot provide an independent second relevance view without semantic duplication
Newer main already implements equivalent ack/replan/reconciliation closure with verified receipts
